title: Al-Ma’thurat — 27-item source sequence
arabicCredit: Qur’an: Tanzil Project, Uthmani text, reproduced verbatim.
translationCredit: Qur’an meaning: Sahih International via Tanzil; non-commercial use only. Other dua translations are original paraphrases for this app.

items.title: Isti’adha, Basmala, and al-Fatihah
items.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللهِ السَّمِيعِ العَلِيمِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ مَـٰلِكِ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ ٱهْدِنَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
items.transliteration: A'udhu billahis-samee'il-'aleemi minash-shaytanir-rajeem. Bismillahir-rahmanir-raheem. Alhamdu lillahi rabbil-'alameen. Ar-rahmanir-raheem. Maliki yawmid-deen. Iyyaka na'budu wa iyyaka nasta'een. Ihdinas-siratal-mustaqeem. Siratal-ladheena an'amta 'alayhim ghayril-maghdubi 'alayhim wa lad-dalleen.
items.translation: I seek refuge in Allah, the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing, from Satan, the rejected. In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. [All] praise is [due] to Allah, Lord of the worlds - The Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful, Sovereign of the Day of Recompense. It is You we worship and You we ask for help. Guide us to the straight path - The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have evoked [Your] anger or of those who are astray.
items.reference: Quran 1:1–7; Sunan Abi Dawud 775; Jami` at-Tirmidhi 242
items.grading: Sahih (Al-Albani, Sunan Abi Dawud 775); Hasan (Darussalam, Jami` at-Tirmidhi 242)
items.note: The cited reports place this formula at the opening of night prayer; its use before al-Fatihah in this sequence is an Al-Ma’thurat convention.

items.title: Opening verses of al-Baqarah
items.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ الٓمٓ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبُ لَا رَيْبَ ۛ فِيهِ ۛ هُدًى لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَيُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ مِن قَبْلِكَ وَبِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدًى مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
items.transliteration: Bismillahir-rahmanir-raheem. Alif-lam-meem. Dhalikal-kitabu la rayba feeh, hudal-lil-muttaqeen. Alladheena yu'minoona bil-ghaybi wa yuqeemoonas-salata wa mimma razaqnahum yunfiqoon. Walladheena yu'minoona bima unzila ilayka wa ma unzila min qablika wa bil-akhirati hum yooqinoon. Ula'ika 'ala hudam-mir-rabbihim wa ula'ika humul-muflihoon.
items.translation: Alif, Lam, Meem. This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah - Who believe in the unseen, establish prayer, and spend out of what We have provided for them, And who believe in what has been revealed to you, [O Muhammad], and what was revealed before you, and of the Hereafter they are certain [in faith]. Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.

items.title: Ayat al-Kursi and the following two verses
items.arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُۥ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَىْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُۥ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ لَآ إِكْرَاهَ فِى ٱلدِّينِ ۖ قَد تَّبَيَّنَ ٱلرُّشْدُ مِنَ ٱلْغَىِّ ۚ فَمَن يَكْفُرْ بِٱلطَّـٰغُوتِ وَيُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ فَقَدِ ٱسْتَمْسَكَ بِٱلْعُرْوَةِ ٱلْوُثْقَىٰ لَا ٱنفِصَامَ لَهَا ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ ٱللَّهُ وَلِىُّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يُخْرِجُهُم مِّنَ ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَوْلِيَآؤُهُمُ ٱلطَّـٰغُوتُ يُخْرِجُونَهُم مِّنَ ٱلنُّورِ إِلَى ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتِ ۗ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
items.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa huwal-hayyul-qayyoom. La ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm. Lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard. Man dhal-ladhee yashfa'u 'indahu illa bi-idhnih. Ya'lamu ma bayna aydeehim wa ma khalfahum. Wa la yuheetoona bi-shay'im-min 'ilmihi illa bima sha'. Wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samawati wal-ard. Wa la ya'ooduhu hifdhuhuma wa huwal-'aliyyul-'adheem. La ikraha fid-deen, qad tabayyanar-rushdu minal-ghayy. Faman yakfur bit-taghuti wa yu'mim billahi faqadistamsaka bil-'urwatil-wuthqa lanfisama laha, wallahu samee'un 'aleem. Allahu waliyyul-ladheena amanoo yukhrijuhum minaz-zulumati ilan-noor. Walladheena kafaroo awliya'uhumut-taghutu yukhrijoonahum minan-noori ilaz-zulumat. Ula'ika as-habun-nari hum feeha khalidoon.
items.translation: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great. There shall be no compulsion in [acceptance of] the religion. The right course has become clear from the wrong. So whoever disbelieves in Taghut and believes in Allah has grasped the most trustworthy handhold with no break in it. And Allah is Hearing and Knowing. Allah is the ally of those who believe. He brings them out from darknesses into the light. And those who disbelieve - their allies are Taghut. They take them out of the light into darknesses. Those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide eternally therein.

items.title: Closing verses of al-Baqarah
items.arabic: لِّلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ وَإِن تُبْدُوا۟ مَا فِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَوْ تُخْفُوهُ يُحَاسِبْكُم بِهِ ٱللَّهُ ۖ فَيَغْفِرُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ ءَامَنَ ٱلرَّسُولُ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۚ كُلٌّ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَمَلَـٰٓئِكَتِهِۦ وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَرُسُلِهِۦ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِۦ ۚ وَقَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۖ غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا ٱكْتَسَبَتْ ۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَآ إِن نَّسِينَآ أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَآ إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِۦ ۖ وَٱعْفُ عَنَّا وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَآ ۚ أَنتَ مَوْلَىٰنَا فَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
items.transliteration: Lillahi ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard. Wa in tubdoo ma fee anfusikum aw tukhfoohu yuhasibkum bihillah. Fayaghfiru liman yasha'u wa yu'adhdhibu man yasha'. Wallahu 'ala kulli shay'in qadeer. Amanar-rasoolu bima unzila ilayhi mir-rabbihi wal-mu'minoon. Kullun amana billahi wa mala'ikatihi wa kutubihi wa rusulih. La nufarriqu bayna ahadim-mir-rusulih. Wa qaloo sami'na wa ata'na ghufranaka rabbana wa ilaykal-maseer. La yukallifullahu nafsan illa wus'aha. Laha ma kasabat wa 'alayha maktasabat. Rabbana la tu'akhidhna in naseena aw akhta'na. Rabbana wa la tahmil 'alayna isran kama hamaltahu 'alalladheena min qablina. Rabbana wa la tuhammilna ma la taqata lana bih. Wa'fu 'anna waghfir lana warhamna. Anta mawlana fansurna 'alal-qawmil-kafireen.
items.translation: To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth. Whether you show what is within yourselves or conceal it, Allah will bring you to account for it. Then He will forgive whom He wills and punish whom He wills, and Allah is over all things competent. The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and [so have] the believers. All of them have believed in Allah and His angels and His books and His messengers, [saying], "We make no distinction between any of His messengers." And they say, "We hear and we obey. [We seek] Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the [final] destination." Allah does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity. It will have [the consequence of] what [good] it has gained, and it will bear [the consequence of] what [evil] it has earned. "Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people."

items.title: Surah al-Ikhlas
items.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ
items.transliteration: Bismillahir-rahmanir-raheem. Qul huwallahu ahad. Allahus-samad. Lam yalid wa lam yoolad. Wa lam yakul-lahu kufuwan ahad.
items.translation: Say, "He is Allah, [who is] One, Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, Nor is there to Him any equivalent."

items.title: Surah al-Falaq
items.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّـٰثَـٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
items.transliteration: Bismillahir-rahmanir-raheem. Qul a'oodhu bi-rabbil-falaq. Min sharri ma khalaq. Wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqab. Wa min sharrin-naffathati fil-'uqad. Wa min sharri hasidin idha hasad.
items.translation: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak From the evil of that which He created And from the evil of darkness when it settles And from the evil of the blowers in knots And from the evil of an envier when he envies."

items.title: Surah an-Nas
items.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَـٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ
items.transliteration: Bismillahir-rahmanir-raheem. Qul a'oodhu bi-rabbin-nas. Malikin-nas. Ilahin-nas. Min sharril-waswasil-khannas. Alladhee yuwaswisu fee sudoorin-nas. Minal-jinnati wan-nas.
items.translation: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, The Sovereign of mankind. The God of mankind, From the evil of the retreating whisperer - Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind - From among the jinn and mankind."

items.title: Sovereignty is Allah’s
items.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ
items.transliteration: Asbahna wa asbahal-mulku lillah, wal-hamdu lillah. La ilaha illallah wahdahu la shareeka lah.
items.translation: We have entered the morning, and sovereignty has entered the morning belonging to Allah. Praise belongs to Allah. There is no deity but Allah alone, without partner.
items.note: Sahih Muslim 2723b gives the morning and evening forms but does not state three repetitions; the count of three follows Al-Ma’thurat.

items.title: Sovereignty is Allah’s
items.arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ
items.transliteration: Amsayna wa amsal-mulku lillah, wal-hamdu lillah. La ilaha illallah wahdahu la shareeka lah.
items.translation: We have entered the evening, and sovereignty has entered the evening belonging to Allah. Praise belongs to Allah. There is no deity but Allah alone, without partner.
items.note: Sahih Muslim 2723b gives the morning and evening forms but does not state three repetitions; the count of three follows Al-Ma’thurat.

items.title: Upon the natural religion of Islam
items.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ وَكَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
items.transliteration: Asbahna 'ala fitratil-islam wa kalimatil-ikhlas, wa 'ala deeni nabiyyina Muhammadin, wa 'ala millati abeena Ibraheema haneefan musliman wa ma kana minal-mushrikeen.
items.translation: We have entered the morning upon Islam’s natural way, the word of sincere devotion, the way of our Prophet Muhammad, and the way of our forefather Ibrahim, upright and devoted to Allah, not among those who associate others with Him.
items.note: Hisn al-Muslim 90 confirms the morning wording; the three-repetition count follows Al-Ma’thurat.

items.title: Upon the natural religion of Islam
items.arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ وَكَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
items.transliteration: Amsayna 'ala fitratil-islam wa kalimatil-ikhlas, wa 'ala deeni nabiyyina Muhammadin, wa 'ala millati abeena Ibraheema haneefan musliman wa ma kana minal-mushrikeen.
items.translation: We have entered the evening upon Islam’s natural way, the word of sincere devotion, the way of our Prophet Muhammad, and the way of our forefather Ibrahim, upright and devoted to Allah, not among those who associate others with Him.
items.note: Hisn al-Muslim 90 confirms the evening wording; the three-repetition count follows Al-Ma’thurat.

items.title: Blessing, well-being, and protection
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ مِنْكَ فِي نِعْمَةٍ وَعَافِيَةٍ وَسِتْرٍ فَأَتِمَّ عَلَيَّ نِعْمَتَكَ وَعَافِيَتَكَ وَسِتْرَكَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni asbahtu minka fee ni'matin wa 'afiyatin wa sitr, fa-atimma 'alayya ni'mataka wa 'afiyataka wa sitraka fid-dunya wal-akhirah.
items.translation: O Allah, I have entered the morning enjoying a blessing, well-being, and Your covering. Complete for me Your blessing, well-being, and protection in this world and the Hereafter.

items.title: Blessing, well-being, and protection
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَمْسَيْتُ مِنْكَ فِي نِعْمَةٍ وَعَافِيَةٍ وَسِتْرٍ فَأَتِمَّ عَلَيَّ نِعْمَتَكَ وَعَافِيَتَكَ وَسِتْرَكَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni amsaytu minka fee ni'matin wa 'afiyatin wa sitr, fa-atimma 'alayya ni'mataka wa 'afiyataka wa sitraka fid-dunya wal-akhirah.
items.translation: O Allah, I have entered the evening enjoying a blessing, well-being, and Your covering. Complete for me Your blessing, well-being, and protection in this world and the Hereafter.

items.title: Blessings and thanks
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصْبَحَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma ma asbaha bi min ni'matin aw bi-ahadin min khalqik, faminka wahdaka la shareeka lak, falakal-hamdu wa lakash-shukr.
items.translation: O Allah, every blessing that has come to me, or to any of Your creation, is from You alone, without partner. To You belongs all praise and thanks.
items.grading: Hasan (Ibn Baz, as cited in Hisn al-Muslim 81)
items.note: The report gives this morning wording once; the evening form is also reported. Al-Ma’thurat sets three repetitions.

items.title: Blessings and thanks
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَمْسَى بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma ma amsa bi min ni'matin aw bi-ahadin min khalqik, faminka wahdaka la shareeka lak, falakal-hamdu wa lakash-shukr.
items.translation: O Allah, every blessing that has come to me, or to any of Your creation, is from You alone, without partner. To You belongs all praise and thanks.
items.grading: Hasan (Ibn Baz, as cited in Hisn al-Muslim 81)
items.note: The report gives this evening wording once. Al-Ma’thurat sets three repetitions.

items.title: Praise befitting Allah’s majesty
items.arabic: يَا رَبِّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ كَمَا يَنْبَغِي لِجَلَالِ وَجْهِكَ وَعَظِيمِ سُلْطَانِكَ
items.transliteration: Ya Rabbi, lakal-hamdu kama yanbaghee lijalali wajhika wa 'atheemi sultanik.
items.translation: My Lord, all praise is Yours, as befits the majesty of Your Face and the greatness of Your authority.
items.note: In Ibn Majah 3801, the servant’s wording has wa li-`azimi; the angels’ repeated wording has wa-`azimi as in this entry. The report does not specify morning/evening or three repetitions; those follow Al-Ma’thurat.

items.title: Pleased with Allah, Islam, and Muhammad
items.arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَبِيًّا وَرَسُولًا
items.transliteration: Radheetu billahi rabban, wa bil-islami deenan, wa bi-Muhammadin sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallama nabiyyan wa rasoola.
items.translation: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, as my Prophet and Messenger.

items.title: Glory and praise in abundance
items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
items.transliteration: Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi, 'adada khalqihi, wa rida nafsihi, wa zinata 'arshihi, wa midada kalimatih.
items.translation: Glory and praise be to Allah as numerous as His creation, as pleasing to Him, as weighty as His Throne, and as abundant as the ink of His words.

items.title: Protection through Allah’s name
items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
items.transliteration: Bismillahil-ladhee la yadurru ma'a ismihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i wa huwas-samee'ul-'aleem.
items.translation: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in the sky can cause harm; He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
items.grading: Hasan (Ibn Baz, for Ibn Majah’s chain; cited in Hisn al-Muslim 86)

items.title: Seeking refuge from shirk
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ نُشْرِكَ بِكَ شَيْئًا نَعْلَمُهُ وَنَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لَا نَعْلَمُهُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inna na'oodhu bika min an nushrika bika shay'an na'lamuhu, wa nastaghfiruka lima la na'lamuh.
items.translation: O Allah, we seek Your protection from knowingly associating anything with You, and we ask Your forgiveness for what we do unknowingly.
items.note: Al-Adab al-Mufrad 716 contains the supplication but gives no repetition count or morning/evening schedule; those follow Al-Ma’thurat.

items.title: Refuge in Allah’s perfect words
items.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
items.transliteration: A'oodhu bi-kalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq.
items.translation: I seek refuge in Allah’s perfect words from the evil of what He has created.
items.note: The cited reports give this wording for staying at a place and in an evening context; they do not specify three repetitions or a morning routine.

items.title: Refuge from anxiety and debt
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ وَقَهْرِ الرِّجَالِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'oodhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wa a'oodhu bika minal-'ajzi wal-kasal, wa a'oodhu bika minal-jubni wal-bukhl, wa a'oodhu bika min ghalabatid-dayni wa qahrir-rijal.
items.translation: O Allah, I seek Your protection from worry and grief, from incapacity and laziness, from cowardice and miserliness, and from being overcome by debt and overpowered by people.
items.note: Sunan Abi Dawud 1555 instructs saying this morning and evening but gives no repetition count; three repetitions follow Al-Ma’thurat.

items.title: Asking for well-being
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma 'afini fee badani. Allahumma 'afini fee sam'i. Allahumma 'afini fee basari. La ilaha illa ant.
items.translation: O Allah, grant well-being to my body. O Allah, grant well-being to my hearing. O Allah, grant well-being to my sight. There is no deity but You.
items.grading: Hasan (Ibn Baz, as cited in Hisn al-Muslim 82)

items.title: Refuge from disbelief, poverty, and the grave’s punishment
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالْفَقْرِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'oodhu bika minal-kufri wal-faqr. Allahumma inni a'oodhu bika min 'adhabil-qabr. La ilaha illa ant.
items.translation: O Allah, I seek Your protection from disbelief and poverty. O Allah, I seek Your protection from the punishment of the grave. There is no deity but You.
items.grading: Hasan (Ibn Baz, as cited in Hisn al-Muslim 82)

items.title: Master supplication for forgiveness
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma anta rabbi la ilaha illa ant. Khalaqtani wa ana 'abduk, wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata't. A'oodhu bika min sharri ma sana't. Ab oo'u laka bini'matika 'alayya wa aboo'u bidhanbi, faghfir li, fa-innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunooba illa ant.
items.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no deity but You. You created me and I am Your servant. I hold to Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favor upon me, and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me; none forgives sins except You.
items.note: Sahih al-Bukhari 6306 gives a by-day or by-night context but does not specify three repetitions; the count follows Al-Ma’thurat.

items.title: Seeking Allah’s forgiveness
items.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
items.transliteration: Astaghfirullaha al-'azeema alladhee la ilaha illa huwal-hayyul-qayyoomu wa atoobu ilayh.
items.translation: I seek forgiveness from Allah the Mighty, besides whom there is no deity, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer, and I repent to Him.
items.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 250; Jami` at-Tirmidhi 3577; Sunan Abi Dawud 1517 (related wording without al-`Azim)
items.grading: Sahih (Al-Albani, as cited in Hisn al-Muslim 250); Hasan (Darussalam, Jami` at-Tirmidhi 3577)
items.note: Hisn 250 and at-Tirmidhi 3577 give the al-`Azim wording; Abu Dawud 1517 has a related wording without al-`Azim. The sources do not set a morning/evening schedule or three repetitions; those follow Al-Ma’thurat.

items.title: Words of glorification and repentance
items.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
items.transliteration: Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdik. Ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant. Astaghfiruka wa atoobu ilayk.
items.translation: Glory and praise be to You, O Allah. I bear witness that there is no deity but You. I ask Your forgiveness and turn to You in repentance.
items.note: Sunan Abi Dawud 4859 places this at the end of a gathering; Hisn al-Muslim 15 also records it after ablution. The three-repetition count follows Al-Ma’thurat.

items.title: Blessings upon Muhammad
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي الْعَالَمِينَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
items.transliteration: Allahumma salli 'ala sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali sayyidina Muhammad, kama sallayta 'ala sayyidina Ibrahim wa 'ala ali sayyidina Ibrahim. Wa barik 'ala sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali sayyidina Muhammad, kama barakta 'ala sayyidina Ibrahim wa 'ala ali sayyidina Ibrahim fil-'alameen. Innaka hameedun majeed.
items.translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim. And grant blessing to Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You granted blessing to Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim throughout the worlds. You are truly Praiseworthy and Glorious.
items.reference: Sahih Muslim 405; Sunan an-Nasa’i 1285 (core wording); Al-Ma'thurat (Imam Hasan al-Banna)
items.note: The Al-Ma’thurat wording adds eight occurrences of sayyidina; that honorific is absent from the cited Sahih Muslim 405 and Sunan an-Nasa’i 1285 formulations.

items.title: Blessings upon Muhammad, his family, and the early Muslims
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَنَبِيِّكَ وَرَسُولِكَ النَّبِيِّ الْأُمِّيِّ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيمًا عَدَدَ مَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُكَ وَخَطَّ بِهِ قَلَمُكَ وَأَحْصَاهُ كِتَابُكَ وَارْضَ اللَّهُمَّ عَنْ سَادَاتِنَا أَبِي بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ وَعُثْمَانَ وَعَلِيٍّ وَعَنِ الصَّحَابَةِ أَجْمَعِينَ وَعَنِ التَّابِعِينَ وَتَابِعِيهِمْ بِإِحْسَانٍ إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّينِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma salli 'ala sayyidina Muhammadin 'abdika wa nabiyyika wa rasoolikan-nabiyyil-ummi, wa 'ala alihi wa sahbihi wa sallim tasleema, 'adada ma ahata bihi 'ilmuk, wa khatta bihi qalamuk, wa ahsahu kitabuk. Wardha Allahumma 'an sadatina Abi Bakrin wa 'Umar wa 'Uthman wa 'Ali, wa 'anis-sahabati ajma'een, wa 'anit-tabi'eena wa tabi'eeyhim bi-ihsanin ila yawmid-deen.
items.translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad, Your servant, Prophet, and Messenger, and upon his family and companions, in abundance known to You and recorded in Your decree. Be pleased with Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman, and Ali, with all the Companions, and with those who followed them in goodness until the Day of Judgment.

items.title: Closing verses of Surah as-Saffat
items.arabic: سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ وَسَلَـٰمٌ عَلَى ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
items.transliteration: Subhana rabbika rabbil-'izzati 'amma yasifoon. Wa salamun 'alal-mursaleen. Wal-hamdu lillahi rabbil-'alameen.
items.translation: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe. And peace upon the messengers. And praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds.

items.title: Wird ar-Rabitah (morning)
items.arabic: قُلِ ٱللَّهُمَّ مَـٰلِكَ ٱلْمُلْكِ تُؤْتِى ٱلْمُلْكَ مَن تَشَآءُ وَتَنزِعُ ٱلْمُلْكَ مِمَّن تَشَآءُ وَتُعِزُّ مَن تَشَآءُ وَتُذِلُّ مَن تَشَآءُ ۖ بِيَدِكَ ٱلْخَيْرُ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ تُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَتُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ ۖ وَتُخْرِجُ ٱلْحَىَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَيِّتِ وَتُخْرِجُ ٱلْمَيِّتَ مِنَ ٱلْحَىِّ ۖ وَتَرْزُقُ مَن تَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذِهِ الْقُلُوبَ قَدِ اجْتَمَعَتْ عَلَى مَحَبَّتِكَ وَالْتَقَتْ عَلَى طَاعَتِكَ وَتَوَحَّدَتْ عَلَى دَعْوَتِكَ وَتَعَاهَدَتْ عَلَى نُصْرَةِ شَرِيعَتِكَ فَوَثِّقِ اللَّهُمَّ رَابِطَتَهَا وَأَدِمْ وُدَّهَا وَاهْدِهَا سُبُلَهَا وَامْلَأْهَا بِنُورِكَ الَّذِي لَا يَخْبُو وَاشْرَحْ صُدُورَهَا بِفَيْضِ الْإِيمَانِ بِكَ وَجَمِيلِ التَّوَكُّلِ عَلَيْكَ وَأَحْيِهَا بِمَعْرِفَتِكَ وَأَمِتْهَا عَلَى الشَّهَادَةِ فِي سَبِيلِكَ إِنَّكَ نِعْمَ الْمَوْلَى وَنِعْمَ النَّصِيرُ اللَّهُمَّ آمِين وَصَلِّ اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ
items.transliteration: Qul Allahumma malikal-mulk tu'til-mulka man tasha'u wa tanzi'ul-mulka mimman tasha'. Wa tu'izzu man tasha'u wa tudhillu man tasha'. Biyadikal-khayr, innaka 'ala kulli shay'in qadeer. Toolijul-layla fin-nahari wa toolijun-nahara fil-layli, wa tukhrijul-hayya minal-mayyiti wa tukhrijul-mayyita minal-hayyi, wa tarzuqu man tasha'u bighayri hisab. Allahumma innaka ta'lamu anna hadhihil-qulooba qad ijtama'at 'ala mahabbatika, waltaqat 'ala ta'atik, wa tawahhadat 'ala da'watik, wa ta'ahadat 'ala nusrati sharee'atik. Fawaththiq Allahumma rabitataha, wa adim wuddaha, wahdiha subulaha, wamla'ha binoorikal-ladhee la yakhboo, washrah sudooraha bifaydil-eemani bika wa jameelit-tawakkuli 'alayk, wa ahyiha bima'rifatik, wa amit'ha 'alash-shahadati fee sabeelik. Innaka ni'mal-mawla wa ni'man-naseer. Allahumma ameen. Wa salli Allahumma 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala alihi wa sahbihi wa sallim.
items.translation: Say, "O Allah, Owner of Sovereignty, You give sovereignty to whom You will and You take sovereignty away from whom You will. You honor whom You will and You humble whom You will. In Your hand is [all] good. Indeed, You are over all things competent. You cause the night to enter the day, and You cause the day to enter the night; and You bring the living out of the dead, and You bring the dead out of the living. And You give provision to whom You will without account." O Allah, You know that these hearts have come together out of love for You, met in obedience to You, united in calling to You, and pledged to support Your way. Strengthen their bond, keep their affection alive, guide them on their paths, fill them with Your light that never fades, open their hearts through faith in You and trust in You, give them life through knowledge of You, and let them die bearing witness in Your cause. You are the best Protector and the best Helper. O Allah, answer us, and bless Muhammad, his family, and his companions, and grant them peace.
items.note: The morning sequence has no counterpart to the sunset-adhan clause cited under the evening entry; this placement follows Al-Ma’thurat.

items.title: Wird ar-Rabitah (evening)
items.arabic: قُلِ ٱللَّهُمَّ مَـٰلِكَ ٱلْمُلْكِ تُؤْتِى ٱلْمُلْكَ مَن تَشَآءُ وَتَنزِعُ ٱلْمُلْكَ مِمَّن تَشَآءُ وَتُعِزُّ مَن تَشَآءُ وَتُذِلُّ مَن تَشَآءُ ۖ بِيَدِكَ ٱلْخَيْرُ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ تُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَتُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ ۖ وَتُخْرِجُ ٱلْحَىَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَيِّتِ وَتُخْرِجُ ٱلْمَيِّتَ مِنَ ٱلْحَىِّ ۖ وَتَرْزُقُ مَن تَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ هَذَا إِقْبَالُ لَيْلِكَ وَإِدْبَارُ نَهَارِكَ وَأَصْوَاتُ دُعَاتِكَ فَاغْفِرْ لِي اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذِهِ الْقُلُوبَ قَدِ اجْتَمَعَتْ عَلَى مَحَبَّتِكَ وَالْتَقَتْ عَلَى طَاعَتِكَ وَتَوَحَّدَتْ عَلَى دَعْوَتِكَ وَتَعَاهَدَتْ عَلَى نُصْرَةِ شَرِيعَتِكَ فَوَثِّقِ اللَّهُمَّ رَابِطَتَهَا وَأَدِمْ وُدَّهَا وَاهْدِهَا سُبُلَهَا وَامْلَأْهَا بِنُورِكَ الَّذِي لَا يَخْبُو وَاشْرَحْ صُدُورَهَا بِفَيْضِ الْإِيمَانِ بِكَ وَجَمِيلِ التَّوَكُّلِ عَلَيْكَ وَأَحْيِهَا بِمَعْرِفَتِكَ وَأَمِتْهَا عَلَى الشَّهَادَةِ فِي سَبِيلِكَ إِنَّكَ نِعْمَ الْمَوْلَى وَنِعْمَ النَّصِيرُ اللَّهُمَّ آمِين وَصَلِّ اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ
items.transliteration: Qul Allahumma malikal-mulk tu'til-mulka man tasha'u wa tanzi'ul-mulka mimman tasha'. Wa tu'izzu man tasha'u wa tudhillu man tasha'. Biyadikal-khayr, innaka 'ala kulli shay'in qadeer. Toolijul-layla fin-nahari wa toolijun-nahara fil-layli, wa tukhrijul-hayya minal-mayyiti wa tukhrijul-mayyita minal-hayyi, wa tarzuqu man tasha'u bighayri hisab. Allahumma inna hadha iqbalu laylika wa idbaru naharika wa aswatu du'atika faghfir li. Allahumma innaka ta'lamu anna hadhihil-qulooba qad ijtama'at 'ala mahabbatika, waltaqat 'ala ta'atik, wa tawahhadat 'ala da'watik, wa ta'ahadat 'ala nusrati sharee'atik. Fawaththiq Allahumma rabitataha, wa adim wuddaha, wahdiha subulaha, wamla'ha binoorikal-ladhee la yakhboo, washrah sudooraha bifaydil-eemani bika wa jameelit-tawakkuli 'alayk, wa ahyiha bima'rifatik, wa amit'ha 'alash-shahadati fee sabeelik. Innaka ni'mal-mawla wa ni'man-naseer. Allahumma ameen. Wa salli Allahumma 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala alihi wa sahbihi wa sallim.
items.translation: Say, "O Allah, Owner of Sovereignty, You give sovereignty to whom You will and You take sovereignty away from whom You will. You honor whom You will and You humble whom You will. In Your hand is [all] good. Indeed, You are over all things competent. You cause the night to enter the day, and You cause the day to enter the night; and You bring the living out of the dead, and You bring the dead out of the living. And You give provision to whom You will without account." O Allah, this is the coming of Your night, the passing of Your day, and the voices of those who call upon You; forgive me. O Allah, You know that these hearts have come together out of love for You, met in obedience to You, united in calling to You, and pledged to support Your way. Strengthen their bond, keep their affection alive, guide them on their paths, fill them with Your light that never fades, open their hearts through faith in You and trust in You, give them life through knowledge of You, and let them die bearing witness in Your cause. You are the best Protector and the best Helper. O Allah, answer us, and bless Muhammad, his family, and his companions, and grant them peace.
items.reference: Quran 3:26–27; Sunan Abi Dawud 530; Al-Ma'thurat (Imam Hasan al-Banna)
items.note: Sunan Abi Dawud 530 supports the sunset-adhan supplication only; the remaining Rabitah litany is a separate Al-Ma’thurat text.
